dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible cluster of five irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned rings on the mid-to-posterior dorsal surface; edges exhibit sharp gradient transitions from dark exterior pelt pixels to high-intensity light-toned annular perimeters enclosing dark centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of light-toned pixel clusters concentrated along the dorsal midline, with localized core pixel saturation occurring within both the ring perimeters and several solid amorphous patches in the neck region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent posterior macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle; a primary anterior high-intensity blob and the nearest macro-annulus centroid form a steep-angled linear relationship relative to the dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized, high-intensity solid white patch is visible on the anterior dorsal ridge, exhibiting higher pixel values and less internal gradient than the surrounding ring patterns.
